hero.sub: Some problems recur often enough that consulting is no longer the right answer. Where the need is repeatable and the solution can stand independently, Rosso Consulting may build a dedicated operating company.

currentVenture.title: Astia Web
currentVenture.label: A Rosso Consulting company
currentVenture.name: Astia Web.
currentVenture.description: A modern hotel website production studio for independent hotel groups, built on a deliberately-chosen MACH stack — Astro, headless CMS, deploy on the edge. Replaces the legacy template-driven hotel website model with something faster, cheaper to maintain, and operator-controllable.
whyExistsParagraphs: Independent hotels spend disproportionate budget on websites that don't perform. Vendors charge enterprise fees for template builds the operator can't control. The handoff is painful. The maintenance is worse.
Astia Web solves the underlying architectural problem. The hotel ends up with a fast, owned, CMS-managed site that costs less in five-year TCO than the legacy alternative.

spinoutLogic.title: When a pattern becomes a venture
spinoutLogic.intro: A pattern becomes a venture only when four conditions are true. Most patterns fail this test and remain as consulting work.

conditions.p: The pattern recurs across multiple clients in similar shape.
The solution can be delivered as a standardised service rather than bespoke consulting.
The unit economics work at the scale the market would support.
The venture serves its market more credibly under its own brand.

parentSpinout.title: How ventures operate
parentSpinout.intro: Three commitments hold for every venture.

commitments.label: Brand
commitments.p: Each venture carries the "a Rosso Consulting company" lockup. The operating brand stays distinct; the provenance stays clear.

commitments.label: Operations
commitments.p: Ventures run their own commercial, product, and operating decisions. The parent provides capital and strategic counsel, not operational control.

commitments.label: Time horizon
commitments.p: Ventures are built to operate as standalone companies long term.

futureVentures.title: Future ventures
futureVentures.lead: Adjacent venture ideas are under deliberate study. They follow the same four-condition test as Astia Web.
futureVentures.paragraph: Ideas under consideration include an AI-native commercial operating system for independent hotels, and a B2B packaging engine for independent tour operators. Neither is ready to spin out.
